about: Regional configuration for scenic shot tours (docs/scenic-tours.md). Geography, named-subject preferences, route anchors and region-dependent parameters live here; DEM sources stay in scenic-views.json. A region's status is its tour's own review state: a view plays its tour in production only when the view and its tour are both approved. Subject lonLat values marked approximate are snapped to the nearest matching DEM feature within snapRadiusM. These are current runtime selection semantics, not prerequisites for authoring or experimenting with a tour; see docs/experimental-development.md.

discovery.horizonNote: Rays that leave the DEM grid within edgeDipDeg below the horizontal are drawn as sky by the app, so the grid's far boundary reads as the horizon; measured in the app up to the deepest band any published camera saw (11.4 deg, Izta) with no visible crop. Before this rule, generators tilted every such view down until no ray left the grid, and high eyes aimed at a subject's mid-height looked 20-35 deg down: 47 of 126 round-2 shots framed no horizon. frame keeps the horizon at least 20% below the top edge while the subject's aim point stays at least 10% above the bottom (docs/scenic-tours.md, Horizon and the grid edge).

budget.trianglesNote: About 18 mesh bytes per triangle plus ~27 MB of surface textures per view; two views are resident across a seam, with forest and sky, inside the low-memory residency budgets (256 MiB desktop, 192 MiB mobile, src/render/GraphicsResidency.js).

nc-ross-lake-north.budgetNote: Wide views over a long lake: each shot brings hundreds of distant tiles (mostly manifest entries), so the default 800 KB fits only three or four shots; raised within the shared Range asset headroom.
nc-ross-lake-north.rebakeOnDriftEvidence: Rail parity after the tour rebake: 0.00% of rail pixels changed at 9 stations (.smoke/scenic-tours/nc-ross-lake-north/rail-parity.json); the drift is below what the rail can show.
nc-ross-lake-north.notes: Ross Lake reservoir between Jack Mountain and the Hozomeen/Pasayten peaks; long north-south water with steep forested flanks.

teton-jackson-lake.budgetNote: Wide views: each shot brings hundreds of distant tiles (mostly manifest entries), so the default 800 KB fits only 3-8 shots; raised within the shared Range asset headroom.
teton-jackson-lake.notes: Jackson Lake under the Teton front: Mount Moran rising straight from the lake, the Grand Teton and Cathedral Group to the south.

denali-wonder-lake.notes: Denali and Mount Foraker above the McKinley River bar and Wonder Lake; enormous relief at long range.

tombstone-north-klondike.blocker: Source drift recorded in the earlier package review: the rail-only bake no longer reproduces the approved package (a rebake changes 3.3% of rail pixels), so the package is kept, and it covers no tour shot. The recorded resolution options were re-pinning the DEM source or reviewing the rebaked rail, followed by a scenic-tour rebuild. Source, rail and tour experiments may continue while compatibility and eligibility work is reported.
tombstone-north-klondike.notes: Granite spires of the Tombstone Range above tundra valleys of the North Klondike.

muncho-lake-south.notes: Muncho Lake in its valley between the Terminal and Sentinel ranges; the lake is the subject as much as the peaks.

historicalExcludedShots.note: Marked broken in the rendered review of the libraries (docs/scenic-tours.md, Rendered review). Historical pre-stratification IDs only; not applied to fresh discovery. Those results apply to the old bytes only. Use observations of rebuilt bytes for new review claims; the historical exclusions do not restrict new shot experiments.

shenandoah-stony-man-west.notes: New BROADLEAF region: compact Blue Ridge escarpment neighborhood. Western rail is a baseline to compare with side/elevation alternatives; it is not a locked discovery azimuth.

superstition-west-front.notes: New DESERT region: Sonoran volcanic wall and pillars, distinct from Panamint basin escarpment. No inferred drainage is treated as surface water.
